name: milton-auth-mail-long-pause
description: milton-auth-mail throttles (Resend 429s) that set a shared delivery pause longer than 900 s, the 15-minute delivery lifetime, so queued mail would expire unsent: the job's JSON line {"message":"auth_mail_pause","seconds":N} (apps/auth/src/mail-log.ts) with N > 900. Read by milton-auth-mail.
filter: resource.type="cloud_run_job" AND resource.labels.job_name="milton-auth-mail" AND jsonPayload.message="auth_mail_pause" AND jsonPayload.seconds>900
